manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pour all the water from the bowl on the left into the bowl on the right.

Task description: The light-green bowl of water on the left is the pouring source; the empty light-green bowl on the right is the receiver. Only the right arm is available. Transfer the water into the right bowl without spilling onto the table.

Success criteria: Nearly all water from the bowl on the left has been poured into the bowl on the right, with no water spilled on the table.

## Execution tips

- Consider grasping the left bowl's wall near the rim, away from the pouring side toward the right bowl, with one finger inside and one outside. Adjust the opening for wall thickness and surrounding clearance. Prefer a dry area where the pads can make full contact, avoiding a grip on the lip alone that could slip.
- Before closing, confirm the fingers are physically inside and outside the bowl wall rather than merely overlapping in the image. During a slight lift, check downward slipping or rotation. If regrasping is needed, support the bottom securely before release.
- Keep the bowl opening facing up during transport, move smoothly, and leave clearance between the water bowl base and right bowl rim to reduce sloshing and collision.
- During pouring, keep the pouring rim near and above the right bowl opening with collision clearance. Increase tilt in small increments and adjust position based on the stream landing point, keeping it safely inside the right rim to reduce overflow and splashing.
- As water decreases, slowly increase tilt and pause briefly to let residual water collect at the pouring side. When righting the bowl, keep that rim above the right opening so remaining drops fall inside.
